''See also: [[Archlord Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Archlords represent a high tier of power within the hierarchy of [[sacred artists]], positioned above Underlord{{!}}Underlords and Overlords but below [[Heralds]] and [[Monarchs]]. Reaching this stage requires a specific [[revelation]] centered on one's future, whereas lower stages focus on the past or present. While many practitioners remain stuck at this level due to a lack of guidance, those who reach the peak of the Archlord realm are considered close to becoming [[Sages]]. Some elite individuals, known as [[Sages]], are regarded as the greatest of the Archlords. Archlords possess immense strength and resilience, capable of producing [[soulfire]] that serves as the peak of traditional soulsmithing. They can exert significant Spiritual pressure{{!}}spiritual pressure, manipulate advanced techniques like [[Enforcer]] workings, and wield powerful sacred instruments. In combat, they can face off against large groups of lower-ranked artists or hold their own against powerful entities. Some Archlords are so advanced that they appear physically solid even as [[Remnants]], while others have achieved such legendary status that they are remembered through ancient records or [[dream tablets]]. The rank is diverse, encompassing various paths and roles, from noble leaders and clan representatives to wandering warriors and specialized combatants.}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|An Archlord represents a level of power greater than [[Gold]], though the true nature of entities like [[Heralds]] and [[Monarchs]] remains a secret to those below this stage. Achieving this rank requires meditating on the future, and failure during [[advancement]] can permanently prevent an individual from ever reaching it. While some like Ziel of the Wasteland{{!}}Ziel achieve this status at a young age, the process can be astronomically expensive and requires building a solid foundation before developing Authority{{!}}authority. At the peak of this stage, the distinctions between [[sacred artists]] and [[sacred beasts]] disappear, and reaching this level through traditional means is necessary to become a true [[Herald]]. Although Archlords are rare and ineligible for tournaments, their presence is immense, as seen when [[Eithan]]'s power covered an entire tower.}}

== Bloodline ==

While some individuals at this level possess the ability to depart [[Cradle]] through their own power, [[Eithan]] is also identified as an Archlord. To enhance his physical form, [[Eithan]] utilized [[soulfire]] to strengthen his Archlord body. Furthermore, reaching the rank of Archlord would provide a solution to the problems facing [[Dross]].}}

== Reaper ==

Reaching this stage requires an individual to possess insight into their own future, and those who achieve it produce the highest form of [[soulfire]]. Historical memories reveal that a group of three Archlords once betrayed one another following the discovery of treasure. During recent events, [[Eithan]] noted a necessity to speak with an Archlord, though [[Yerin]] has not yet advanced to this level.}}

== Dreadgod ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|An Archlord represents a specific stage of power and a rank of nobility among [[dragons]]. [[Helethshan]] is an [[Everwood]] Archlord, appearing as a blue-crystal entity covered in angular crystals with a pyramid positioned over his head. This entity utilizes gemstones that carry practiced [[madra]] control and focused will, and can even focus attacks on a specific target. During the events near [[Redmoon]], [[Helethshan]] tested [[Moongrave]]'s [[boundary field]] by hurling fifty trees at the walls. While Ziel of the Wasteland{{!}}Ziel held this rank without reaching its peak, [[Lindon]] eventually advanced to become an Archlord himself.}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Archlord represents a powerful [[advancement]] level that is achieved through an individual's own decision rather than by the heavens. Those following the [[Path of Seven Pages]] can reach the peak of this stage, a milestone that allows for a clearer sensing of [[Icons]]. While Archlords are formidable figures who may carry massive swords and possess distinct eyes featuring colored circles, they remain subject to hierarchy. For instance, [[Charity]] issues orders to her Archlords, and certain individuals have been seen kneeling before [[Northstrider]].}}

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|“Now we come to the mental tests,” the Archlord continued. “Reaction speed, memory, force of will, and resistance to incursion.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c2" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|“Archlords aren’t eligible for the tournament,” Eithan said<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c8" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|“Not a peak Archlord. And I had always seen myself as more of a Herald than a Sage anyway.”<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c6" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|“The heavens don’t decide when you advance to Archlord,” he said, without opening his eyes. “You do.”<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c13" />}}
